title: What was the largest ethnic group in Wexford County schools in 2024-25 school year?
text:
A majority of students in Wexford County schools were white in the 2024-25 school year, according to the Michigan Department of Education .
Of the 8,564 students enrolled in Wexford County schools, 73.5% were white. African American students were the second-largest ethnicity, making up 12.9% of enrollment.
In the previous school year, white students were also the largest ethnic group, accounting for 71.1% of the student body.
Highpoint Virtual Academy of Michigan had the most balanced distribution of students by ethnicity, including 48.3% white students, 30.7% African American students, 10.2% multiracial students, 9.1% Hispanic students, 1% Asian students, 0.7% American Indian students, and 0.1% Hawaiian students.
Total enrollment in Wexford County schools increased by 8.2% in the 2024-25 school year compared with the previous year.
In the 2025-26 school year, over 1.41 million students were enrolled in Michigan schools , a drop of about 5.3% from the nearly 1.45 million recorded before the pandemic in the 2019-20 school year. White student enrollment saw the largest decline, dropping by about 5.8%
